description: A Hyperliquid wallet's event history, by `view`. `fills`: raw fills, newest first (`size_usd`, `closed_pnl` in USD; `fee` is in its own `fee_token`). `funding`: funding payments, `payment_usd` signed from the wallet's side (negative = the wallet PAID). `ledger`: deposits, withdrawals, transfers and vault events with `amount_usd`. `builders`: the builder codes the wallet's flow is routed through, by volume (`share_of_volume` is of its builder-routed volume only, not of all its trading). Keyset-paged: pass `nextCursor` back; it is null on the last page. Same data as GET /v1/hyperliquid/wallets/{address}/{fills, funding, ledger, builders}.

address.description: Hyperliquid wallet address: 0x followed by 40 hex characters, any case. Required.

cursor.description: `nextCursor` from the previous page, passed back verbatim; it is null on the last page. Omit it for the first page.

end.description: ISO-8601 UTC upper bound, e.g. 2026-10-02T00:00:00Z. Used by view: fills, funding, ledger.

event_type.description: One ledger event type; an unknown value is refused, not answered with an empty list. Used by view: ledger.

limit.description: Rows per page, newest first. Default by view: fills 100, funding 100, ledger 100, builders 50. Max by view: fills 5000, funding 5000, ledger 5000, builders 500.

side.description: `buy` or `sell`. Omit for both. Used by view: fills.

start.description: ISO-8601 UTC lower bound, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. Used by view: fills, funding, ledger.

symbol.description: Hyperliquid instrument ticker, e.g. BTC, ETH, HYPE; a HIP-3 market is `dex:TICKER`, e.g. xyz:TSLA. Omit for all symbols. Used by view: fills, funding.

view.description: What to read. `fills`: raw fills, newest first. `funding`: funding paid and received, newest first. `ledger`: deposits, withdrawals, transfers and vault events, newest first. `builders`: which builder codes the wallet's flow is routed through, by volume. Default `fills`.

window.description: Window of the builder-routed flow: `1d`, `7d`, `30d` or `all`. Used by view: builders.

name: hl_wallet_activity
title: Hyperliquid Wallet Activity
